narrative.overview:
The interface behaves like the grid it is drawn on: a construction grid stays visible in the shell, and every case occupies exactly one cell in it. The grid is the measurement the work is read against, so it is left showing rather than painted over.

Density is the point. Coordination staff scan roughly 140 open cases a day, so contrast is spent on data rather than on the frame: hard 1px ink rules instead of shadows, zero radii, and a near-white ground that lets one saturated plane mean something. When a case misses its deadline its whole cell turns that plane, so the exception is found before a label is read.

The system refuses the category defaults: status pills, equal KPI card grids, and rounded soft-shadowed containers. Expression lives in the type scale and the grid.
keyCharacteristics: Visible 36px construction grid behind every screen
One saturated plane #1246d9 reserved for missed deadlines and the single primary action
Monospace for anything measured, Archivo for anything read
The deadline number at each cell's floor is the primary data of every list

rules.name: The One Plane Rule
rules.body: The saturated blue may appear on at most one cell per viewport band and one control per screen. Its rarity is what makes a missed deadline readable at a glance.

rules.name: The No-Colour-Only Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries a state by itself. Late cells also print a negative number and the word escalated; unowned cases print no owner.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Values compared across rows are set in Spline Sans Mono with tabular figures; sentences are set in Archivo. There is no third case.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A section heading carries itself. No small uppercase kicker sits above a heading anywhere in the product.

rules.name: The Border-Or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a border. A soft shadow added to a card, cell, or panel is a defect, not a variation.

dos: Do put the deadline's distance at the floor of every list row or cell, as a signed number in tabular figures.
Do keep the construction grid visible in the shell at #dfe6f1 and nowhere inside a data region.
Do print provenance next to every extracted value: source file, character offset, read time.
Do name the reason in an exception list rather than showing a count alone.
Do disable an action a role cannot take, keep it legible, and state why beside it.
Do set every compared value in Spline Sans Mono with tabular-nums.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by removing the cell settle entirely.
donts: Don't introduce status pills, rounded badges, or a second accent colour.
Don't add box-shadow anywhere, including hover states and floating panels.
Don't round a corner on buttons, chips, inputs, notices, or cells.
Don't use #ffffff as a page ground; it is reserved for inputs and notice panels above #fbfbf9.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't nest a bordered container inside another bordered container.
Don't imply automatic closure in copy or layout; the engine proposes, a clinician confirms.
